construction: Enumerate inclusive calendar dates; keep Monday-Friday except exact official full-closure dates below. Open 09:30 America/New_York. Close 13:00 on exact official early-close dates, 16:00 otherwise. Convert both to UTC with zoneinfo, honoring DST. No generic federal-bank-holiday calendar and no inferred extra pre-holiday early close. Historical January9,2025 mourning closure is also explicitly excluded. Full-year lists are retained for audit, while CSV starts October1,2024.
special_cases: 2027-12-31 is a regular session: January 1, 2028 falls Saturday and NYSE explicitly observes no New Year holiday.
2028-07-03 is a 13:00 ET early close; 2028-07-04 is fully closed.
No additional early close on July 2, 2027 or December 23, 2027 is listed by NYSE.
Bank holidays such as Columbus/Indigenous Peoples Day and Veterans Day are not excluded unless separately listed by NYSE.
2025-01-09 is explicitly excluded as an exceptional full closure; it was not in the original annual holiday announcement.
Warmup/calibration completeness is checked against this independent official calendar, never inferred from dates that happen to exist in market data.

limitation: Scheduled equity sessions only, not a guarantee against subsequent exceptional closures, halts or rule changes.
